$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for coverage in this repo; overrides any skill's own coverage logic. This project has THREE stacks, so the flat `thresholds`/`enforcement` pair below is the PYTHON gate (the only one enforced today) and `stacks` carries the per-stack detail. Do NOT lower the Python numbers: pyproject.toml `addopts` enforces them independently, so relaxing them here would create two disagreeing sources of truth.

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. If coverage drops below any threshold, the task fails.

python.note: Also enforced independently by `addopts` in pyproject.toml, so a bare `python -m pytest` already fails below 100%. Measured 1261 passing at 100% branch coverage at HEAD 3a0cdbe. Do not pass `-q` on top of addopts: it becomes `-qq` and SUPPRESSES the pass/fail summary line, which reads as a broken suite.

typescript.note: 100% is the agreed TARGET, set deliberately before it is reachable so the goal is unambiguous. MEASURED 2026-08-07 under `environment: "node"`: 75.85% statements (1156/1524), 77.84% branches, 76.33% functions, 74.80% lines, over the 17 modules some test loads. That number FLATTERS the codebase: six runtime modules are imported by zero test files and are therefore excluded from the denominator entirely - app.ts, main.ts, ui/reader.ts, ui/search.ts, graph/canvas.ts, graph/elkLayout.ts. (ipc/types.ts is also absent but has 0 runtime statements, so that one is correct, not a gap.) CORRECTION - an earlier version of this note said the missing DOM makes those modules STRUCTURALLY untestable. That was wrong in three ways, each measured: (1) virtualList.ts is loaded and covered at 4.41%, so it is partially tested, not structurally excluded; (2) ipc/real.ts sits at 3.03% with ZERO DOM references - it is blocked on mocking @tauri-apps/api, and is testable under node today; (3) elkLayout.ts needs a browser `Worker` and canvas.ts needs a 2D CanvasRenderingContext2D, and jsdom implements NEITHER, so switching environment does not unblock those two at all. Flipping to jsdom on its own was measured to change coverage by exactly zero. A DOM is necessary for app/reader/search/scrubber/virtualList and sufficient for none of them; the actual missing thing is tests.
typescript.unblockedBy: Write the tests. Order by cost: ipc/real.ts and elkLayout.ts need no DOM at all; app/reader/search/scrubber/virtualList need jsdom ADDED ALONGSIDE new tests (the environment flip alone is a no-op); canvas.ts and elkLayout.ts's worker path stay browser-only and are covered by the headless probes in cockpit/tools/ instead. Flip blockPRCreation/blockTaskCompletion to true only once measured.
typescript.reportingGotcha: The vitest terminal table hides files at 100% on all metrics, so it lists 10 of the 17 measured modules and reads as if seven tested files were missing. Read coverage-summary.json (`--coverage.reporter=json-summary`) for the real per-file list.

rust.note: 18 tests exist. No coverage instrumentation is configured (cargo-tarpaulin is not installed) and none is planned for the first release; `cargo test` passing is the bar. As of HEAD 3a0cdbe these have never run in CI - see Phase 1d.
